trigger_condition.description: A critical zero-day vulnerability is detected in a core framework.

action: Freeze all non-essential CI/CD deployment pipelines and force an immediate patch out of band.

trigger_condition.description: Cloud server CPU utilization exceeds 85% for more than 5 minutes.

action: Auto-scale infrastructure by provisioning additional compute instances behind the load balancer.

trigger_condition.description: Database replication lag exceeds 60 seconds during peak traffic.

action: Temporarily route all read queries to the primary database to prevent users from seeing stale data.

trigger_condition.description: A new mobile app update triggers a crash rate above 1%.

action: Halt the phased app store rollout immediately and rollback users to the previous stable build.

trigger_condition.description: Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) on a specific ad channel exceeds the target by 20%.

action: Pause the underperforming campaign and automatically reallocate the budget to the highest-converting channel.

trigger_condition.description: An organic social media post experiences a 500% spike in engagement.

action: Immediately allocate a designated 'slush fund' budget to boost the post as a paid advertisement to capitalize on the algorithm.

trigger_condition.description: Email campaign unsubscribe rates spike above 2% within the first hour.

action: Abort the remainder of the email send queue and trigger a review of the content formatting and audience segmentation.

trigger_condition.description: E-commerce shopping cart abandonment exceeds historical averages for 2 hours.

action: Trigger an automated, time-sensitive sequence offering a 10% discount code to recover the lost sessions.

trigger_condition.description: Pipeline coverage drops below 3x the required quarterly revenue target by mid-quarter.

action: Launch an emergency outbound prospecting 'spiff' (short-term incentive) to motivate the sales development team.

trigger_condition.description: An enterprise deal worth over $100k sees no communication from the buyer for 14 days.

action: Flag the account as 'at-risk' in the CRM and automatically loop in an executive sponsor for peer-to-peer outreach.

trigger_condition.description: A primary overseas supplier delays a critical component shipment by more than 48 hours.

action: Auto-route the backordered volume to a secondary, local supplier despite higher unit costs to prevent production halts.

trigger_condition.description: Inventory for a high-velocity SKU drops below 7 days of trailing sales data.

action: Trigger an expedited freight reorder to restock warehouses before a stockout occurs.

trigger_condition.description: A high-priority (Severity 1) support ticket remains unassigned for 15 minutes.

action: Escalate the ticket automatically and trigger a PagerDuty alert to the on-call engineering manager.

trigger_condition.description: A high-value enterprise client submits a Net Promoter Score (NPS) below 6.

action: Flag the account for a high churn risk and require the Customer Success Manager to schedule an intervention call within 24 hours.

trigger_condition.description: Operational cash flow drops below a predefined 4-month runway threshold.

action: Automatically freeze all non-essential hiring requisitions and halt travel and entertainment (T&E) budget approvals.
